reason: I don't take supplements unless a doctor tells me to, and nobody has told me I need magnesium. I already forget the vitamins on my counter, so a daily sachet would mostly sit there.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I have no real reason to think I need magnesium in the first place.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor recommending magnesium, or a blood test showing I am low.
